anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a software tool and technical specification for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, not the specific dataset content.

anchors.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
anchors.reason: The paper introduces iEEG-BIDS, a specification for organizing and sharing iEEG data, which is a technical standard/methodology, not a paper describing the specific stimuli or data in on003352.

metadata.methods_description: Visual stimuli consisting of eight square wave spiral gratings (10 degrees visual angle) and two color words were presented for 116 ms each. Stimuli included light and dark variants of pink, blue, green, and orange spirals, as well as the words 'blue' and 'green' displayed in white on a gray background. Intracranial electrophysiological (iEEG) recordings were acquired during stimulus presentation using implanted electrodes.
